ios.desc:
Plume: Word of the Day — read a better word every day.

Every day Plume hands you one carefully chosen word: a literary definition, real example sentences, and clear pronunciation. No flashcards, no pressure — just a word worth reading, like a page from a good book.

A STORY BEHIND THE WORD
- Over 100 word-origin stories
- Today's story sits on the back of the day's word card
- Where a word came from, what it meant first, and why it still matters
- Sources listed on every story - you can check them
- Earlier stories live in your library under "Words with stories"
- Today's story is always free

What's in Plume:
 - One hand-picked word every day, with a polished bilingual gloss
 - Chinese definitions now FREE — beautiful serif typography (Source Han Serif SC)
 - Clear, natural pronunciation across 7 languages (English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese) with 3 voices — Juno, Atlas, Wren
 - Browse a curated corpus by category; collect words and phrases into your library
 - Practice quizzes, daily goals, and streaks that count every kind of learning activity
 - Progress heatmap, level & category stats, and shareable progress cards
 - Works fully offline — no account, no ads, privacy-friendly

Plume Pro unlocks every language, all three voices, and full statistics. Basics stay free forever.
